requirements.text: Great-circle distance between coordinates is computed in meters
Latitudes and longitudes outside valid ranges are rejected
Nearby search narrows candidates with an index-friendly bounding box or geohash before exact distance checks
Searches near the poles and the antimeridian return correct results
Results within the radius are returned nearest first with a limit and pagination
Large datasets use a spatial index (for example PostGIS GiST) for radius queries
Exact locations of other users are not exposed; results reveal only rounded distance or area
